content.value: An aluminum rod rigidly is rigidly attached between a steel rod and a bronze rod as shown in figure. Axial loads are applied at the positions indicated. Find the maximum value of P that will not exceed a stress in steel of 140 MPa, in aluminum of 90 MPa, or in bronze of 100 MPa.

I(c) A cylindrical steel pressure vessel 400 mm in diameter with a wall thickness of 20 mm is subjected to an internal pressure of 4.5 $\mathsf { M N } / \mathrm { m } ^ { 2 }$ (i) Calculate the tangential and longitudinal stresses in the steel. (ii) To what value may the internal pressure be increased if the stress in the steel is limited to 120 $M N / \ m _ { 2 }$ (iii) If the internal pressure were increased until the vessel burst, sketch the type of fracture that would occur.
